ValidationRule.description:
#16611 : Restrict opportunities from moving stages if the Total Annual Amount >TCV and Contract Terms is > 12 and force the seller to reevaluate the values in those fields
#17293 : Added other stages.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( NOT( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR( ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity') ) ),
OR( PRIORVALUE(IsClosed)<> IsClosed, NOT(IsClosed) ),
Amount >= Total_Contract_Value_TCV__c, Contract_Term_months__c>12,
QTB_APIProcess__c = false, NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For opportunities with a Contract Term greater than 12 months, the Total Annual Amount cannot be equal to or greater than the Total Contract Value.
